successors.name: Kingdom of Saba
successors.text: the territory of Awsan after its destruction by Saba and its allies in the late 7th century BC

successors.name: Qataban
successors.text: half of the divided territory of Awsan (page's reading; undated beyond the late 7th century BC)

successors.name: Kingdom of Hadramawt
successors.text: the other half of the divided territory of Awsan

ledger.x: 8th century BC: Awsan arises at Wadi Markha.
late 7th century BC: Saba destroys Awsan.
late 7th century BC: the kingdom of Awsan ends.

wars.name: Sabaean and Awsanite campaigns against Qataban
wars.outcome: 'Together, Saba and Awsan undertook successful military ventures against Qataban' in the 8th century BC; no border change is dated.

wars.name: Karib'il Watar's destruction of Awsan
wars.outcome: Awsan destroyed by Saba and its allies; the land divided between Qataban and Hadhramaut (a statement the page calls 'evidence' of the division).

certainty.note: The Wadi Markha core is archaeologically unexplored; no border of Awsan is described.
